name: B10-0580/2025 (ESN) – Mass kidnapping of children in Nigeria, including from St Mary’s Catholic School in Papiri
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the mass kidnapping of children in Nigeria, including from St Mary’s Catholic School in Papiri
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns the mass kidnapping of 303 students and 12 teachers from St Mary's Catholic school in Papiri, Nigeria, on 21 November 2025. It calls on Nigeria to fight corruption, strengthen its police and courts, and reform its intelligence services. It also asks the European Union to prioritise security support to Nigeria. The text is a statement of position and a set of requests; it does not change any law.

- Nothing changes in law; the Parliament only states its position and makes requests.
- The requests are aimed at Nigeria's government and at the European Commission and the EU's foreign service.
- Next, the resolution is sent to EU institutions, member states and Nigeria's government and parliament.
